items.description: Block Tower TD 2 is a strategic game in the roguelike style with original innovations. Build worlds from blocks, choose random upgrades, each game will be unique.Build the World!Unleash your potential in creating defensive strategies, playing in a world where every block is important for your defense. Create unique tactics by placing blocks in the right places.Build the TowersTower placement is a key aspect in Tower Defense games. Especially in Block Tower: build them on elevations, leave space for resources, cleverly combine blocks. Each tower has an experience bar: the earlier it is built, the stronger it becomes at the end of the game. Skilful tower placement will make your defense stronger and more efficient.Choose UpgradesThe sequence of upgrades plays a crucial role in progressing through each stage. Optimize your strategy based on resources, magical towers, or fortified defense. The random block generation, combined with tactical decisions, gives the game almost endless replayability.Harvest ResourcesDevelop your economic strategy wisely. Early investment in economic buildings can be risky but will provide a significant advantage in the end. The random distribution of resources in each game creates new strategic challenges, requiring your creative approach and decision-making skill. items.description: "Dino Goodbye!" is an absurd satirical visual novel about a dinosaur civilization marching confidently toward extinction like it has a branding strategy for the apocalypse.You play as Doctor Thunderasaur, the scientist who discovers that a giant meteor is on its way. Instead of urgent action, he gets TV nonsense, political theater, oligarch schemes, influencer chaos, and entire crowds of dinosaurs who would rather argue about optics than survive.Expect:- sharp comedy and black humor;- branching choices that change the road to the ending;- political satire with maximum prehistoric nonsense;- a world full of dinosaurs making terrible decisions with incredible confidence;- one unavoidable finale, because the meteor does not care about approval ratings.It is a story about science, denial, panic, stupidity, and one final scream that arrives exactly on schedule. Every level pulls you deeper.There is no rescue. There is only the next kill.EVERY SHOT COUNTS10+ weapons — fists, katanas, shotguns, magnums, miniguns, railgunsThrow your blade — turn any melee weapon into a lethal projectileDash through death — slip past bullets and reposition in a blinkDestructible walls — tear the arena apart with heavy firepower BOSSES WANT YOU DEADEach boss brings its own deadly pattern — charges, bullet storms, teleports, freezing blasts, homing rounds and raining meteors. items.description: INCREDECK is an incremental game featuring three distinct stages with different gameplay mechanics. Please note — this is not a collectible card game, but an incremental game with bullet-hell elements.Three stages of the game:Card Collection Stage. Collect cards dealt from decks and earn points to spend on upgrades and automation. Bullet-Hell Stage. Use your collected cards to attack the Joker, dodge his projectiles, and claim victory. Secret Stage?The game starts like a typical clicker. You will need to click on cards with your mouse to collect them. The money earned this way can be spent on buying new card decks, increasing deck sizes, boosting card profits, enabling automatic collection without clicking, and much more. When battling the Joker, you can use your collected cards to attack the enemy. Different cards have different uses. The incremental element never goes away — you will also be upgrading your attacking cards. After victory, a secret stage will unlock, which you'll discover in the game.Features:Automation. Purchase upgrades to simplify and speed up your earnings.Big Numbers. Start with a small income and grow it to trillions!Pixel Art. Charming visuals crafted by a professional artist.30+ Achievements. items.description: A wild island, an endless forest and a single axe. Build a logging empire from scratch: fell trees, raise sawmills and factories, hire crews, buy machines and turn raw logs into boards, lumber, furniture and paper. A 3D economic logging tycoon with living machinery, workers and ecology.You start with an axe, some seed money and a coniferous plot. Mark trees for cutting and your loggers get to work. Logs must be hauled to the warehouse, processed on the machines and driven by trucks to the customs house or dock, where goods are finally sold. Every link in that chain can be automated: chainsaws, harvesters, log trucks, inter-island barges, machine operators and haulers running the logistics.Grow the full production chain: log → board → lumber → dried lumber → product → furniture. Unlock alternative branches — a paper mill and a charcoal plant. Build roads, generators, fuel depots and ports, take bank loans, watch a market with floating prices and grab lucrative supply contracts.But the forest is alive. Cut too greedily and ecology drops, trees regrow slower, the island empties out. Hire foresters, plant saplings and hold the balance between profit and regrowth. Seasons change, and with them the growth rate and fuel costs. Open new zones and neighbouring islands — from deciduous groves to mountain cedars and ancient relic giants.The goal is simple and ambitious: turn a lonely plot into an industrial logging empire with a net worth of 10,000,000 ₽.KEY FEATURES:A FULL PROCESSING CHAIN. Log → board → lumber → dried lumber → product → furniture, plus paper and charcoal. Every stage adds value;LIVING MACHINES & WORKERS. Loggers, haulers, operators and foresters; chainsaws, harvesters, log trucks, trucks and sea barges between islands — all driving, felling and hauling right in front of you;ECONOMY & LOGISTICS. A floating market, contracts, a bank with loans, maintenance, fuel and electricity. Build three tiers of roads to speed up delivery;ECOLOGY MATTERS. Logging lowers forest health; planting restores it. Keep the balance — or end up on a barren island;AN ISLAND WORLD. 7 tree species, 4 biomes and separate islands linked by ports and barges. Unlock zones as you grow;SEASONS. Spring, summer, autumn and winter change tree growth and fuel use;15 STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS;TWO LANGUAGES: Russian and English, auto-detected on first launch.From your first felled tree to a logging empire — the whole island is yours.
